en.fd.prompt.step: What could {name} do next that would help?
en.fd.how: Read the story and look for clues. Pick a feeling that might fit. There can be more than one good answer. Then choose a kind next step.
en.fd.fb.strong: Yes, that fits well. Lots of people would feel that way.
en.fd.fb.okay: That could be true too. People feel different things in the same moment.
en.fd.fb.unlikely: Hmm, that might not fit as well here. Look at the clues and try another feeling.
en.fd.fb.helpful: That is a kind and helpful choice.
en.fd.fb.notHelpful: That might make things harder. What else could help?
en.fd.fb.okay2: That could work for some people.
en.fd.summary.note: Feelings are never right or wrong. Naming them helps us look after ourselves.
en.fd.e1.scene: Bo built a very tall tower out of blocks. Then it wobbled and fell down with a crash.
en.fd.e1.c1: Bo's tower is in pieces on the floor.
en.fd.e1.c2: Bo's shoulders are drooping and Bo is frowning.
en.fd.e1.s1: Take a slow breath, then build it again.
en.fd.e1.s2: Ask a friend to help build a new one.
en.fd.e2.scene: Pip walked into the room and everyone shouted, "Happy birthday!" There was a cake and balloons.
en.fd.e2.c1: Pip's eyes are wide open and Pip is smiling.
en.fd.e2.c2: Pip did not know about the party.
en.fd.e2.s2: Take a quiet moment if it feels like a lot.
en.fd.e2.s3: Shout at everyone to go away.
en.fd.e3.scene: Fox asked a friend to play. The friend said, "Not today." Now Fox is sitting alone.
en.fd.e3.c1: Fox's tail is low and Fox is looking at the ground.
en.fd.e3.s1: Ask someone else if they would like to play.
en.fd.e3.s2: Draw a picture or read a book for a while.
en.fd.e3.s3: Say something mean about the friend.
en.fd.e4.scene: It is a stormy night. Thunder is booming and Turtle is under the blanket.
en.fd.e4.c1: Turtle's head is pulled inside the shell.
en.fd.e4.c2: Each thunder boom makes Turtle jump.
en.fd.e4.s1: Hug a soft toy and breathe slowly.
en.fd.e4.s2: Tell a grown-up who can keep Turtle company.
en.fd.e4.s3: Run outside to find the thunder.
en.fd.m1.scene: Panda has a big show tomorrow. Panda keeps thinking about it and cannot sit still.
en.fd.m1.c2: Panda has been practising and really wants to share the show.
en.fd.m2.scene: Octo showed a new drawing to the class. A classmate giggled and pointed at it.
en.fd.m2.c2: Octo quickly hides the drawing under the desk.
en.fd.m2.s1: Tell a trusted grown-up what happened.
en.fd.m2.s2: Take a breath and remember what you like about your drawing.
en.fd.m3.scene: Flutter won a small prize at the school fair. Flutter's best friend did not win one.
en.fd.m3.c1: Flutter is holding the prize and smiling a little.
en.fd.m3.c2: Flutter glances at the friend, who looks quiet.
en.fd.m3.s1: Tell the friend, "You did great too."
en.fd.m3.s2: Offer to share the fun of the prize.
en.fd.m4.scene: Sprout's family will move to a new house next week. Boxes are piling up in the hall.
en.fd.m4.c1: Sprout keeps looking at their old bedroom.
en.fd.m4.c2: Sprout has never seen the new house yet.
en.fd.m4.s1: Talk to family about how it feels.
en.fd.m4.s2: Pack a box of favourite things to keep close.
en.fd.h1.scene: Fox waited at the park for a long time for a friend who never came. Later the friend said, "Sorry, my bus broke down and my phone had no battery."
en.fd.h1.c1: Fox sat on the bench for a long time.
en.fd.h1.c2: The friend looks sorry and a bit upset too.
en.fd.h1.s1: Accept the sorry and plan another day.
en.fd.h1.s2: Calmly say how it felt to wait.
en.fd.h1.s3: Never talk to the friend again.
en.fd.h2.scene: Pip is working on a hard puzzle. A friend finishes theirs first and starts cheering.
en.fd.h2.c1: Pip is frowning and rubbing their head.
en.fd.h2.s1: Take a short break, then try again.
en.fd.h2.s2: Ask for a hint, or for help.
en.fd.h2.s3: Throw the puzzle across the room.
en.fd.h3.scene: Bo's best friend has a new friend. The two of them whisper and laugh together, and Bo sits nearby.
en.fd.h3.c1: Bo keeps glancing over at the two of them.
en.fd.h3.c2: Bo hasn't been asked to join in.
en.fd.h3.s1: Kindly tell the friend, "I feel a little left out."
en.fd.h3.s2: Spend time on something you enjoy, or with another friend.
en.fd.h4.scene: Turtle has been asked to speak first in class. Turtle's hands are shaking.
en.fd.h4.c2: Turtle also really wants to share an idea.
en.fd.h4.s1: Take a slow breath and say, "I need a moment."
en.fd.h4.s2: Ask the teacher if you can go second.
en.fd.h4.s3: Decide you can never speak in class.
